title: KIRITSU
description: A smart contract is the most un-biased yet trustworthy accountability partner. Kiritsu allows you to make good habits and break bad ones by allowing you to stake your money in a smart contract. It tracks your activities using various api's available and won't hesitate to take it away from you if found guilty.
how_its_made: Working with chainlink was not as easy as I thought, it provides no error if it fails which led me to do a lot of guesswork to solve the bugs. This was almost my first time using next.js and it took me a while to learn how to use it, in hindsight I should have probably gone for something like Vue js. The biggest challenge I ran into was the deadline, building a smart contract, front end and a fully functioning backend in 36 hours all alone proved to be a tough task. Ultimately I failed, but choosing this path allowed me to learn the most.
